title: Chapter 153 - 153 Buying Beauty Water; Discuss Something
content:
Chapter 153 - 153 Buying Beauty Water; Discuss Something

Chapter 153 - 153 Buying Beauty Water; Discuss Something

153 Buying Beauty Water; Discuss Something

Lin Fan and Chu Yunyue spent some time together before they went to the private kitchen.

Perhaps it was because New Year’s Day had just passed, a few red lanterns appeared in the restaurant.

In addition to the small bridge and flowing water, the green tiles and red bricks made the entire place’s antique atmosphere even more intense.

The two of them ordered food and chatted with each other for a while.

At this moment, Lin Fan’s phone vibrated.

12:00!

The red packets were here!

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received two yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 10,00 yuan.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained Flying Dragon Security Company.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 19,999 yuan.]

…

After Lin Fan received the red packets, a series of unique delicacies were served.

Both of them were very satisfied with the meal.

Then, Chu Yunyue returned to the company to continue handling matters.

Lin Fan headed toward the Coiling Dragon Villa Complex.

Lin Fan had just walked into the villa when the phone in his pocket rang.

“Is this Mr. Lin?” An unfamiliar voice sounded on the phone.

“It’s me,” Lin Fan said.

“Hello, Mr. Lin. I’m the general manager of Flying Dragon Security Company, Wang Shengli. You’re welcome to come to Flying Dragon Security Company anytime to make your arrangements…” Wang Shengli said respectfully.

Flying Dragon Security Company?

Was this not the company that he had just received from the red packet?

Arrange work?

Lin Fan’s eyes moved. “Does Flying Dragon Security Company have trucks?”

“Yes! We have many different types of trucks!” Wang Shengli said.

“Alright then. Get someone to drive two trucks to the Coiling Dragon Villa Complex in Jiangbei City. Do you know where it is?”

“I know, I know! Don’t worry, Mr. Lin. We’ll rush to Coiling Dragon Villa Complex in the shortest time possible!” Wang Shengli’s voice was sonorous and powerful.

After Lin Fan hung up, he bought a large number of plastic buckets.

Then, he spent 50 million yuan to buy 5,000 liters of Beauty Water from the system and put them all into the plastic buckets.

Lin Fan waited for a while before two trucks drove over from afar.

A square-faced man got out of the front passenger seat of one of the trucks and quickly walked in front of Lin Fan. He said respectfully, “Hello, Mr. Lin! I’m Wang Shengli, who just spoke to you on the phone.”

“Hello, CEO Wang,” Lin Fan said.

“Oh, you can’t do that!” Wang Shengli quickly said. “Mr. Lin, you can just call me Lil Wang.”

Wang Shengli was probably over 40 years old.

Lil Wang?

Lin Fan really could not bring himself to call him that.

“I’ll call you Brother Wang,” Lin Fan said.

“Don’t, don’t. This is even more unacceptable.” Wang Shengli shook his head repeatedly with a look of fear and trepidation.

In the end, Lin Fan chose to call him by his name. Only then did Wang Shengli accept it.

“Wang Shengli, send these buckets to Flower Stem in Feiyang Building. Do you know the location?” Lin Fan said.

“Mr. Lin, don’t worry. There’s no place in Jiangbei that we’re not familiar with! I promise to complete the mission!” Wang Shengli patted his chest and said.

With the help of several security staff members, the 5,000 liters of Beauty Water were quickly loaded into the trucks before the trucks drove out.

At this moment, Lin Fan’s phone vibrated.

It was a message from his girlfriend, Qin Yuxuan.

Lin Fan contacted Qin Yuxuan on WeChat almost every night.

However, she rarely took the initiative to send messages during the day.

Qin Yuxuan said: [Lin Fan, I want to discuss something with you.]

Lin Fan said: [Sure, I have nothing to do today. I’ll come to Modu to discuss it with you later. We haven’t seen each other for a while.]

Qin Yuxuan: [You’re coming over? That’s great!]

Obviously… Qin Yuxuan was very happy.

Lin Fan was a person who would do whatever he said. He immediately bought a first-class ticket.

Then, he drove the Lamborghini toward the airport.

When he arrived at the airport, Lin Fan’s phone rang.

“Heavens! Lin Fan, you actually sent over so much essence!” Chu Yunyue’s excited voice rang out as soon as the call connected.

Lin Fan said, “Is it enough?”

“It’s enough!” Chu Yunyue shouted immediately. “It’s too much! Do you know? We just analyzed the essence and found that its vitality and effects are more than a thousand times that of all the beauty products in the world!

“More than a thousand times! Did you know this? Oh my God! I almost couldn’t believe my eyes!

“In other words, even if this essence is diluted 100 times, the effect of it is still far beyond the beauty products on the market!

“Our essence will definitely become a hit!”

Chu Yunyue’s tone became extremely high-spirited as she reached the end of her sentence. She wished she could shout out in excitement.

Lin Fan said, “That’s good. Let me know when the essence is almost used up. I’ll get someone to send it to you again.”

The two of them chatted for a while more before hanging up.

Then, Lin Fan checked his ticket and boarded the plane through the VIP channel.

It was only an hour’s flight from Jiangbei to Modu.

Lin Fan lay down on the spacious seat in the first-class cabin and had a relaxing sleep. Then, he arrived at his destination.

After leaving the airport, he called a taxi.

When Lin Fan arrived at Modu University, it was only four in the afternoon.

The brilliant sun was still hanging high in the sky, showing no signs of setting.

Lin Fan took out his phone and sent a message to Qin Yuxuan.

However, Qin Yuxuan was probably busy and did not pay attention to her phone.

Therefore, she did not reply immediately.

Lin Fan did not care too much.

The last time he came to Modu University was to celebrate Qin Yuxuan’s birthday, but he did not visit the university.

He had a chance today.

Most of the buildings in Jiangbei University were tall, modern, and full of modern style.

Modu University, on the other hand, had traces of time, giving people a sense of humanity and history.

Lin Fan looked around as he walked. Unknowingly, he had arrived at the teaching building. Many students rushed toward the classroom in front of him.

Seeing this…

Lin Fan could not help but think of Hu Tian’s class.

Could it be that the teacher who was about to teach in this classroom at Modu University was also a beauty like Hu Tian?

However, was it not the weekend today?

Why would there be classes?

Lin Fan followed them into the classroom curiously and sat in one of the few remaining seats in the corner.

Ding!

After the bell rang, the entire classroom immediately fell silent.

Under the anticipation of Lin Fan and many other students, a short-haired female professor in her 40s walked in slowly with a textbook.

Lin Fan could not help but reveal a puzzled look.

Why was she not a beautiful teacher?

Why was everyone so enthusiastic, then?

However, since he was here, he should take it as it was.

Moreover, Lin Fan did not know where else to go.

Therefore, he sat in the classroom calmly.

The female professor did not notice Lin Fan and started her lesson.
